caption: The drawing depicts a figure of a man standing on a black, four-footed pedestal base. The man is dressed in historical attire including a dark blue or black bicorne hat decorated with a yellow flower, a red coat with gold buttons, a white shirt, tan or brown breeches, and tall black boots. His face is round and fleshy, and he has a neutral expression with short curly dark hair visible under the hat. The man’s hands are positioned at his stomach, holding a round clock with a white face and black numerals in front of his torso. The clock face has an additional smaller dial near the top and is labeled "FORELAND" in its center. The background is plain and beige, and there are no other objects in the drawing.
title: Magic Lamp Clock in 18th Century Figure
